description: Implicit Context ($ctx) — Pool-allocated struct implicitly available in every proc. Carries ambient state (pwd, user-declared fields). Explicit forking via with-ctx. Per-field mutability enforcement.

userStories.title: Ctx pool — GC-managed free-list
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a pool of pre-allocated ctx struct objects with a lock-free free-list so that with-ctx forking is fast and GC-safe.
acceptanceCriteria: Ctx structs are allocated as OBJ_STRUCT GC objects (have GCHeader, traced normally)
JaclCtxPool struct holds: atomic free-list head, struct_size, type_idx, pool head is a GC root
ctx_pool_init allocates 8 ctx structs via gc_alloc and links them in the free-list
ctx_pool_alloc pops from free-list via atomic CAS; on empty, allocates fresh via gc_alloc
ctx_pool_free clears reference fields (set to JACL_NIL) then pushes to free-list via atomic CAS
Free-list next pointer stored at byte 0 of struct data[] (overlaps with field data, valid only when in pool)
Pool head pointer is registered as a GC root so pooled entries are not collected

Test: free and re-alloc reuses the same object (pool hit)
Test: pool exhaustion falls back to gc_alloc (pool miss)

userStories.title: with-ctx — explicit forking primitive

userStories.title: SM integration — ctx across suspension points
